doc: Manufacturing / machining rules. Every panel becomes operations; machining logic lives OUTSIDE SketchUp drawing code for scalability.
source: Fabricating Cabinets Learner Guide (System 32, cutting lists, edging, assembly)
IKEA METOD (suspension rails, fillers, install order)
Installation Requirements + Installing On-Site learner guides
session_level_title: LEVEL 18,19,27,28,40 — BACKS, PLINTHS, MACHINING, CUT LIST

system32.so: THE coordinate system for cabinet interiors. THE root cause fix.
system32.concept: rows of 5mm holes on the internal faces of all vertical panels, spaced at 32mm centres
system32.rule: DO NOT hard-code every hole. Hardware references the System 32 grid. Rods, shelves, drawers, hinges snap to grid.

configurations.dwg: sides grooved, back sits IN groove (rebated)
back only where needed (e.g. behind sinks)

backs.software_model: BackConfiguration { type, thickness, inset, groove_depth, groove_width, service_gap }

styles.note: PB/MDF, nailed/stapled/screwed, cross-supports NOTCHED at bottom for uneven floors; installed full-length on-site then levelled, THEN cabinets on top (LMFKB3005A p53)
CAPITA / METOD leg 8cm; hidden behind plinth or exposed (METOD p13)
recessed toe kick built into cabinet

plinth_toe.software_model: Plinth { height, front_inset, side_inset, construction, leg_spacing, finish_panel }

fillers_scribes.so: FILLER != CABINET, END_PANEL != CABINET_SIDE, SCRIBE_PANEL != FILLER (Level 20). Real walls bow/lean/taper and contain pipes, columns, skirting, cornices.
fillers_scribes.rule: never assume wall_width = sum(cabinets); account for fillers and scribes at the ends

materials.so: Materials are independent of geometry. Never `board_thickness = 18`; use `cabinet.carcase_material.thickness`. Changing 18->16 must propagate everywhere.

edgebanding.rule: know whether cut-size dimensions are BEFORE or AFTER edging (production tolerance)
edgebanding.range: 0.07mm - 2.00mm (LMFKB3005A p41); thickness affects door/drawer gap, so set before cutting
edgebanding.mozaik: Edgebanding Assignment Template, up to 4 bandings per cabinet (Banding 1=box parts, 2=doors/drawer fronts, 3=drawer box parts)

grain_direction.matching_grain: grain_group_id, sequence_index, source_sheet (for nesting + visual continuity)

machining.software_model: DrillOperation { x, y, z, diameter, depth, face }

order: build suspension rails (base first, then wall), leveled pre-hang
wall cabinets first (except single-line with high cabinet -> high first)
fillers at walls; support strip to hold filler
drawer rails fitted to carcase BEFORE doors/shelves

quality_control.kwcma: ANSI/KCMA A161.1 performance standard: a geometrically valid cabinet is not necessarily a structurally valid cabinet

NO_INTERPENETRATION_RULE.so: GLOBAL HARD RULE (user-mandated): except for a CONNECTOR, and except for the BACK SHEET sitting INTO a groove, NOTHING penetrates or nests inside another material/panel. Drawer boxes ride on runners in the OPENING - they are never modelled as penetrating into a panel. Every part is a separate, non-overlapping solid; panels JOIN by butt/edge/face, not by being nested inside one another.
allowed_penetrations: connectors (cam pocket into a panel face; bolt/dowel into a mating edge - these ARE machined INTO material by design)
back sheet seated into a groove (dado/rebate) in the sides
forbidden: a drawer box solid overlapping/tangent-penetrating a side, bottom, or rail panel
any panel solid nested inside another panel's volume
any accessory solid buried inside carcase material
NO_INTERPENETRATION_RULE.validation: engine must assert bounding-box disjointness for every pair of non-connector parts; a conflict = FAIL the build, never silently overlap.

GOLA_OVERLAP_RULE.so: TRUE handleless finger-pull geometry (learned from build_luxury_gola_kitchen_master.rb). Drawer fronts OVERLAP the Gola profiles by design - the front extends INTO the L-Gola channel at top and INTO the C-Gola channel at mid, so the finger grab is real, not a gap.
GOLA_OVERLAP_RULE.note: Gola L (H56.5, D26) and C (H73, D26) profiles seat RECESSED 26mm behind the front plane; fronts overlap them, front plane is proud by FRONT_THK.

FACING_DIR_RULE.so: Gola profile channel opening direction must match the run (learned from build_luxury_gola_kitchen_master.rb). Wall run channel opens -Y; island channel opens +Y (into the aisle). Same profile, flipped by facing_dir.
FACING_DIR_RULE.note: This is the 'sense of direction' rule - every Gola/handleless profile and every connector is placed by a facing vector, never a guessed coordinate.

DRAWER_BOX_5_PIECE_RULE.so: Authentic undermount drawer box (learned from build_luxury_gola_kitchen_master.rb Hettich Actro 5D). True 5-piece construction, rides on concealed runners in the opening - NEVER penetrates panels.
pieces: RECESSED bottom (16mm sitting 12mm up inside the sides)
DRAWER_BOX_5_PIECE_RULE.front: decorative drawer front, FRONT_THK, overlaps Gola profiles (see GOLA_OVERLAP_RULE)

SELECTIVE_DRILLING_RULE.so: CNC drills ONLY where hardware connects (Minifix, dowels, slide runners, hinge plates). No grid/no unnecessary holes. System 32 is a coordinate for placement, not a guarantee every hole gets drilled (learned from build_luxury_gola_kitchen_master.rb).
